{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, void)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO
import Network.Socket
import Data.Word (Word64)

-- Rate limiter using token bucket algorithm
data RateLimiter = RateLimiter
  { rlBuckets   :: TVar (Map String TokenBucket)
  , rlCapacity  :: Int
  , rlRefillRate :: Double  -- tokens per second
  , rlShutdown  :: TVar Bool
  }

data TokenBucket = TokenBucket
  { tbTokens    :: !Double
  , tbLastTime  :: !UTCTime
  }

data ProxyState = ProxyState
  { psLimiter     :: RateLimiter
  , psConnCount   :: TVar Int
  , psDraining    :: TVar Bool
  , psGracePeriod :: NominalDiffTime
  }

newRateLimiter :: Int -> Double -> IO RateLimiter
newRateLimiter cap rate = do
  buckets <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  shutdown <- newTVarIO False
  return $ RateLimiter buckets cap rate shutdown

-- Refill tokens based on elapsed time
refillBucket :: Double -> Int -> UTCTime -> TokenBucket -> TokenBucket
refillBucket rate cap now bucket =
  let elapsed = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (tbLastTime bucket)) :: Double
      newTokens = min (fromIntegral cap) (tbTokens bucket + elapsed * rate)
  in TokenBucket newTokens now

-- Check if request is allowed under rate limit
-- During graceful shutdown, rate limits remain enforced
checkRateLimit :: ProxyState -> String -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit ps clientId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let limiter = psLimiter ps
      effectiveCap = rlCapacity limiter  -- consistent limit regardless of state
  atomically $ do
    buckets <- readTVar (rlBuckets limiter)
    let bucket = case Map.lookup clientId buckets of
          Just b  -> refillBucket (rlRefillRate limiter) effectiveCap now b
          Nothing -> TokenBucket (fromIntegral effectiveCap) now
    if tbTokens bucket >= 1.0
      then do
        let bucket' = bucket { tbTokens = tbTokens bucket - 1.0 }
        writeTVar (rlBuckets limiter) (Map.insert clientId bucket' buckets)
        return True
      else do
        writeTVar (rlBuckets limiter) (Map.insert clientId bucket buckets)
        return False

-- Handle incoming connection
handleConnection :: ProxyState -> Socket -> SockAddr -> IO ()
handleConnection ps sock addr = do
  let clientId = show addr
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psConnCount ps) (+1)
  allowed <- checkRateLimit ps clientId
  if allowed
    then do
      -- Forward request to backend (simplified)
      sendAll sock "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nProxied\n"
    else do
      sendAll sock "HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\r\n\r\nRate limited\n"
  close sock
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psConnCount ps) (subtract 1)

-- Initiate graceful shutdown
initiateShutdown :: ProxyState -> IO ()
initiateShutdown ps = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (psDraining ps) True
  putStrLn "[proxy] Entering graceful shutdown, draining connections..."
  -- Wait for existing connections or grace period
  startTime <- getCurrentTime
  let waitLoop = do
        count <- readTVarIO (psConnCount ps)
        now <- getCurrentTime
        let elapsed = diffUTCTime now startTime
        if count == 0 || elapsed > psGracePeriod ps
          then putStrLn "[proxy] Shutdown complete"
          else threadDelay 100000 >> waitLoop
  waitLoop
  atomically $ writeTVar (rlShutdown (psLimiter ps)) True

-- Signal handler simulation - external trigger sets draining
-- In production this would be connected to SIGTERM
triggerDrain :: ProxyState -> IO ()
triggerDrain ps = atomically $ writeTVar (psDraining ps) True

sendAll :: Socket -> String -> IO ()
sendAll sock msg = void $ send sock (encodeUtf8 msg)
  where encodeUtf8 = id  -- simplified

main :: IO ()
main = do
  limiter <- newRateLimiter 10 2.0  -- 10 tokens, 2/sec refill
  connCount <- newTVarIO 0
  draining <- newTVarIO False
  let ps = ProxyState limiter connCount draining 30
  -- Main accept loop
  sock <- socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol
  bind sock (SockAddrInet 8080 0)
  listen sock 128
  putStrLn "[proxy] Listening on :8080"
  forever $ do
    shutdown <- readTVarIO (rlShutdown limiter)
    unless shutdown $ do
      (conn, addr) <- accept sock
      void $ forkIO $ handleConnection ps conn addr
